scope: Twelve selected Technology draft identities: four corrected technical objectives and eight category/context/option retirements. Risk-selected sample, not a contiguous prefix or full-category audit. Pure science and instrument anatomy are not blanket-retired.

replacements.sourceClaim: NASA distinguishes absent global lunar magnetism from localized magnetic regions. Its Cosmicopia compass answer separately explains the navigation limitation.
distractorReview: Key: NASA identifies no global lunar field, while retaining localized fields.
Air: the cited compass explanation identifies magnetic reference, not an atmosphere requirement.
Liquid water: neither source makes a body of water a compass operating requirement.
Sunlight: the cited magnetism explanation says a carried magnet still attracts iron on the Moon; sunlight is not an off switch.
replacements.contextDecision: Replace the absolute cannot-be-used claim and no-magnetic-field choice with a navigation-specific global/local distinction.

replacements.sourceClaim: Samsung explicitly expands IC as integrated circuit and describes combined components. Analog Devices confirms the device definition but also lists an alternate pin-label use, so the stem specifies the device context.
distractorReview: Input controller: not the source’s device-name expansion.
Instruction counter: not the source’s device-name expansion.
Key: both manufacturers explicitly name the device integrated circuit.
Interface cable: a cable is not the combined semiconductor device in the definition.
replacements.contextDecision: Scope the acronym to the semiconductor device and remove Integrated Chip as a competing synonym.

replacements.sourceClaim: HPE’s Where does the name Cray come from section names Seymour Cray, the 1972 founding, and his Cray-1 design. A separate HPE history URL timed out and is not relied on as a successful page read.
distractorReview: Charles Babbage: not the founder/designer named in HPE’s account.
Key: the source names Seymour Cray for this specific relation.
Bill Gates: not the founder/designer named in this account.
Steve Jobs: not the founder/designer named in this account.
replacements.contextDecision: Correct the keyed person’s misspelled surname Gray to Cray under a new identity; replace a vague honorific with a dated company/design relation.

replacements.sourceClaim: Intel article 000028294 states that system memory dedicated solely to IGD is never available for regular system memory. Article 000020962 distinguishes a reported shared-memory limit from an ongoing reservation. This item assumes an explicit firmware reservation rather than diagnosing a numeric RAM discrepancy.
distractorReview: Fully available: contradicts the documented solely dedicated reservation.
Disk storage: source assigns this portion to graphics uses, not permanent storage.
Key: source expressly excludes the reserved portion from regular system memory.
Doubled capacity: dedicating part of existing RAM does not create more physical memory.
replacements.contextDecision: Replace the unproved most-likely diagnosis from a numeric discrepancy with an explicit firmware-reservation premise; no universal shared-memory reservation or byte-unit claim.
